intro: Live Beacon combines verified platform start events into one Discord notification. The webhook stays only in Streamer.bot and is never stored, logged, or exported by StreamBridge.

sections.title: 1. Quick setup
sections.notice: Create private webhooks in the chosen Discord channels or forums, put them in the imported Deliver action, then Save and Compile. Leave Deliver triggerless and approve it here. A genuine platform start performs the live test.

sections.title: 2. Choose where notifications are posted
sections.description: Recommended: create one Discord forum named Live Notifications, create one webhook for that forum, and let every platform use the shared fallback. Live Beacon creates a separate post for each platform.
sections.notice: Discord webhooks are tied to one destination. The wizard cannot move one webhook between different forums. Only use a platform-specific setting when that platform has its own private webhook in Streamer.bot; otherwise leave it on Use shared fallback.

sections.title: 3. Create posts or use posts you already made
sections.description: Choose one simple setup path. Existing IDs take priority and are never treated as secrets.
sections.notice: Create for me: leave the IDs blank. On each platform's first genuine live event, Live Beacon creates one permanent post and remembers it. Use existing posts: enable Discord Developer Mode, right-click each post, choose Copy Channel ID, and paste IDs for your selected platforms here.

sections.title: 4. First message for automatically created posts
sections.description: These messages are used once when Create for me makes a platform post. {channel} becomes your configured channel/login.

sections.title: 5. Notification delivery
sections.description: Each selected platform gets its own linked embed instead of one combined post.

sections.title: 6. Broadcast-app fallback
sections.description: Use OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs Desktop when a platform has no native start event.
sections.notice: Recommended: select only TikTok. In Streamer.bot, attach your active broadcast app's Streaming Started trigger to THSV Addon - Live Beacon - Broadcast Started. Fallback events know the start time and direct link, but cannot automatically know the stream title or game/category.

sections.title: 7. Embed message and details
sections.notice: Provider events display Stream title, Game / Category, Direct link, and Started time. A missing provider value is omitted rather than invented.

sections.title: 8. Direct live links
sections.description: Enter a login or channel page once; Live Beacon creates viewer-ready live links.
sections.notice: YouTube Broadcast Started supplies the exact video ID, so its Discord embed goes straight to youtube.com/watch?v=.... The saved YouTube channel URL is only a fallback and becomes .../live. TikTok uses @handle/live.

sections.title: 9. Rich embeds and shared metadata
sections.description: Show the stream details promised in the welcome message. Missing metadata may come from another active platform; the notification still links to its own platform.
